articles.headline: Anthropic adds free Claude Code credits for cloud sessions
articles.dek: Anthropic now offers a separate free‑credit bucket for Claude Code runs that execute on its hosted cloud infrastructure.

body.text: Key Takeaway

Anthropic introduced a free‑credit tier that applies only when Claude Code is executed inside Anthropic‑hosted cloud sessions, keeping those credits distinct from your regular usage quota [FACT:d047bd8cfa842963e55f1d0b4c533e30].
Why This Matters

Builders can prototype or test Claude Code without dipping into their paid quota, but they must migrate workloads to the cloud side of Anthropic’s platform to qualify for the free tier [FACT:581d77b7631e9351fa1557261c205049][FACT:7051ba56b50fd480bb8a071a6b07974a].
What Happened

Anthropic’s service now runs Claude Code on its own hosted infrastructure and marks those runs as cloud sessions, which are the only ones that draw from the new free‑credit bucket [FACT:581d77b7631e9351fa1557261c205049][FACT:7051ba56b50fd480bb8a071a6b07974a].
Builder View

If you’re already using Claude Code locally you’ll hit the normal limit, but you can continue for free by switching to a cloud session – the platform will automatically charge the free bucket instead of your regular balance [FACT:3a96437b8b3eb6e5918661f7c40c1f93].
Ardur Take

Two independent sources confirm the free‑credit bucket is cloud‑only and separate from regular usage, so teams that can tolerate the extra latency of a hosted session should start there to preserve paid credits [FACT:d047bd8cfa842963e55f1d0b4c533e30][FACT:581d77b7631e9351fa1557261c205049].
